description: A white paper cup sits on the table in front, with a purple toothbrush and a small toothpaste tube nearby. The right hand reaches into the cup, lifts out the right-hand toothbrush, while the left hand picks up the left-hand toothpaste tube, twists off the cap, and squeezes a dab of toothpaste onto the toothbrush bristles held steady in the right hand.
